newsitem.title: USA: Cowboys' Irvin and Williams suspects in sex assault case.
newsitem.headline: Cowboys' Irvin and Williams suspects in sex assault case.

text.p: Dallas Cowboys superstars Michael Irvin and Erik Williams are under investigation for allegedly sexually assaulting a woman who said she was raped at gunpoint at Williams' home, police said on Tuesday.
Dallas police Lieutenant David Goelden said no formal charges had yet been filed against Irvin or Williams but that the two Pro-Bowl stars and another man were being investigated.
He said the 23-year-old woman alleged that a gun was placed against her head and she was raped at Williams' home on Sunday night while one of the suspects videotaped the assault.
"She reported she had been sexually assaulted by the two players as well as a third unidentified man," Goelden said.
It is the latest in a string of scandals to rock the Cowboys team, which has won the Super Bowl for three of the last four seasons and is again in the playoffs.
Irvin, 30, earlier this year pleaded no contest to felony cocaine possession charges after police found him and a former Cowboys player in a motel room with two topless dancers.
